CSE-4042                                                                                                                   about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 25-Nov-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VII Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  software Engineering [CSE-4042]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           You are assigned a software development project with evolving requirements and a high  
  need for early testing. Apply your understanding of the Waterfall Model and its  
  extensions to choose the most appropriate model for this scenario. Justify your choice by (5)  
  A)      explaining how the selected model addresses the project's needs.  
  
  B)      Your team is working on a project where customer feedback is expected to change  
  frequently during development. Apply Agile development principles to explain how  
  your team would handle these changes. Mention which specific Agile practices would           (3)  
  be most beneficial in this scenario.  
  
  C)      The Spiral Model is drawn as a multi-loop spiral, with each loop representing one  
  iteration of the development process. Draw and label the basic skeleton of the Spiral        (2)  
  Model, highlighting its key phases.  
  
  2)           You are tasked with gathering and analyzing requirements for a new e-commerce  
  website. Apply appropriate techniques to identify, document, and prioritize the needs of  
  various stakeholders. Explain how you would ensure that the requirements are complete (5)  
  A)      and aligned with business goals.  
  
  B)      You have been assigned to create a Software Requirements Specification (SRS)  
  document for an online food delivery application. Apply the key sections of an SRS  
  document to organize the requirements effectively. Briefly explain how each section          (3)  
  helps ensure the system meets stakeholder expectations.  
  
  C)      Identify the steps to apply user-centered design principles to improve the usability of a  
  mobile application.                                                                          (2)  
  
  3)           Draw the sequence diagram for the use-case scenario "Create New Library User  
  Account" by identifying appropriate synchronous and asynchronous messages. Analyze  
  (5)  
  the object creation and deletion and fragments.  
  A)  
  B)      A company is developing an e-commerce platform where customers can browse  
  products, place orders, and manage their accounts. Choose the important concepts and         (3)  
  terminologies associated with a layered design for e-commerce platform.  
  
  C)      Develop a state diagram for a Ticket object in a ticketing system. Include states such as    (2)  
  Available, Booked, Cancelled, and Closed.

  4)              Draw a Level 1 DFD for a library management system, breaking down the key processes  
  from the context diagram. Identify the main data stores, data flows, and processes that  
  (5)  
  interact with external entities.  
  A)  
  B)         You are tasked with designing a library management system for a university. The system  
  allows students and faculty to search for books, borrow them, and return them.  
  Librarians are responsible for adding new books, managing overdue fines, and           (3)  
  maintaining the catalog. Draw a Use Case Diagram for the library management system,  
  and analyze their interactions with the system.  
  
  C)         Consider an online shopping system where customers browse products and place orders.  
  Class: Product  
  Attributes: productID, name, price, stock.  
  Methods: updateStock(), applyDiscount().  
  Class: Order                                                                           (2)  
  Attributes: orderID, orderDate, totalAmount.  
  Methods: calculateTotal(), addProduct().  
  Identify the role of objects and classes in the OOAD methodology for a given scenario.  
  
  5)              You are tasked with testing a new e-commerce website. Apply the principles of  
  functional testing to describe how you would ensure the system meets user  
  requirements. Outline the steps you would take and the specific aspects of the website    (5)  
  A)         you would test.  
  
  B)         You suspect there are memory leaks in a software application you're developing. Apply  
  a program analysis tool to find and address memory-related issues in your code.           (3)  
  
  C)         Apply the Singleton pattern to design a logging system for an application. How would  
  this ensure only one instance of the logger exists?                                       (2)  
  
  
  -----End-----
